📺 The Long Song (2018)

The Long Song follows July, a strong-willed young enslaved woman living on a sugar plantation in Jamaica during the final years of slavery in the 1830s. Separated from her mother at a young age, July grows up under the control of the plantation’s demanding mistress, Caroline Mortimer, while dreaming of freedom and a better future. As the British Empire moves toward abolishing slavery, tensions rise between plantation owners and enslaved workers, bringing dramatic changes to their lives. When a new overseer, Robert Goodwin, arrives, July becomes involved in a complicated relationship that challenges her hopes for happiness and independence. Through heartbreaking experiences, unexpected betrayals, and moments of courage, she fights to maintain her dignity and determine her own destiny. Featuring powerful performances and emotional storytelling, The Long Song explores slavery, injustice, resilience, love, freedom, and the extraordinary strength of the human spirit.

🎭 Genre: Drama • History

⭐ IMDb: 7.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: 3 episodes • Approximately 60 minutes each • TV-MA

🎥 Director: Mahalia Belo

✍️ Writer: Sarah Williams, based on the novel by Andrea Levy
